validity.description: Synthetic grouped recruitment selected to verify exact state boundaries, path accounting, continuity, and time-step-independent transit.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Präzisionsmedizin, Section 4.4, pp. 127-128
sources.role: precapillary sphincter and activity-dependent recruitment concept

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M4.4 dynamic capillary recruitment contract, version 1.0.0
sources.role: synthetic state schedule and boundary-condition semantics

limitations: Path counts and event times are synthetic software-test values, not physiological evidence.
Each group is an aggregate gate for identical parallel paths, not an anatomical map of individual sphincters.
Fixed total flow is an imposed boundary condition and does not derive pressure or vascular resistance.
The schedule has no feedback, autoregulation, vasomotion, hematocrit, or stochastic recruitment.
